text.p: Borg-Warner Security Corp and privately held Wingate Partners said Monday they completed an agreement combining Wingate's Loomis Armored and Borg-Warner Security's Wells Fargo Armored operations.
The combined company, known as Loomis, Fargo & Co, is owned 51 percent by the former Loomis shareholders and 49 percent by Borg-Warner Security.
The transaction allowed Borg-Warner Security to reduce its debt by about $100 million.
The new company will employ 8,500 people with annual revenues of about $375 million.

James Mattly, chief executive officer of Loomis Armored, is chief executive officer and president of the new company which will provide a full range of armored transportation, automated teller machine services and cash vault services.
